description: Every city one city in Europe or Southeast Asia flies to non-stop over the next three months or so (or that a big airport outside the region flies to, any stops), cheapest first: each with its cheapest fare, the day, its age and airline, how many days have fares and the airlines, and links to each route's page on faredice.com.

from.description: A city by name ("Berlin", "Krakow", "Saigon") or IATA city code ("BER"). For a long flight, one end can be a big airport outside the region we have fares from (Vancouver, Toronto, New York, Sydney, London for Southeast Asia ...).

max_results.description: Most cities to list, cheapest first. Default 30.

region.description: europe or southeast-asia. Default: the first region where both places are found, Europe first.

name: nonstop_from
title: Every city a city flies to non-stop
